description: This file defines custom error classes related to MongoDB connection pool errors, such as PoolClosedError, PoolClearedError, PoolClearedOnNetworkError, and WaitQueueTimeoutError. These classes extend existing error classes and are used internally within the MongoDB driver to represent specific error conditions like closed or cleared connection pools and timeout scenarios.

classes.name: PoolClosedError
classes.description: Error indicating a connection pool is closed.

classes.name: PoolClearedError
classes.description: Error indicating a connection pool is currently paused or cleared.

classes.name: PoolClearedOnNetworkError
classes.description: Error indicating the connection pool was cleared after server monitor timeout.

classes.name: WaitQueueTimeoutError
classes.description: Error thrown when a request to check out a connection times out.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Constructors for each error class initialize the error with specific messages and store relevant pool information.

methods.name: name getter
methods.description: Overrides the name property to return a specific string identifying the error type.
